requirements.title: Complete causal compile
requirements.positive_acceptance: Every directed owner effect bound to real plan and visible consequence
requirements.required_negative_control: Delete producer; owner effect fails even with camera moving

requirements.title: Global semantic state independent of shot
requirements.positive_acceptance: Cross-action and cross-shot persistent contact; random seek deterministic
requirements.required_negative_control: Remove continuation; reuse wrong contact id

requirements.title: Channel ownership and evaluation order
requirements.positive_acceptance: Concurrent gaze, emotion, speech and grip with explicit ownership
requirements.required_negative_control: Conflict or silent overwrite; mandatory effect missing

requirements.title: Successor phase inheritance
requirements.positive_acceptance: Split vs continuous phase state/pixels/audio match
requirements.required_negative_control: Stale/wrong/missing predecessor and lost crossing cue

requirements.title: Real prop driver and transform authority
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual hand-driven prop pixels; object-driven and surface-driven alternatives; transfer
requirements.required_negative_control: Disable driver consumer; conflicting writer; invalid transfer

requirements.title: Contact geometry/orientation
requirements.positive_acceptance: Position and orientation constraints solved on real contacts
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing basis; reversed palm; flipped elbow; incompatible simultaneous grips

requirements.title: Genuine PINCH and WRAP
requirements.positive_acceptance: PINCH with opposing patch contacts and WRAP layering
requirements.required_negative_control: Same-side fingers, floating patch, generic fist, missing art

requirements.title: Full support locomotion (articulated plus cels)
requirements.positive_acceptance: Two unlike biped gait profiles with planted foot and carry; gait cel route
requirements.required_negative_control: Foot slide, impossible stride, root-only glide, unsupported topology

requirements.title: Continuous articulated silhouette and material integrity
requirements.positive_acceptance: Seam/hidden paint/silhouette valid across intermediate frames
requirements.required_negative_control: Middle-frame hole, scale/stretch, detached limb or shadow

requirements.title: Reach, point, idle, body/head turn and hold
requirements.positive_acceptance: Correct target, view edge, directed hold and release
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong target, flat yaw, mid-hold break, camera-only motion

requirements.title: Carry/load/insert and object reactions
requirements.positive_acceptance: Carry, load and insert physical object consequence and hinge where required
requirements.required_negative_control: Teleport, release too early, wall penetration, false follower

requirements.title: Support and collision policy
requirements.positive_acceptance: Support/collision intent and approved tolerance checks
requirements.required_negative_control: Floating grounded owner, collision, excessive drift

requirements.title: Runtime mutation tests and measured pixel checks
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual renderer and owner-specific frame evidence
requirements.required_negative_control: Zero frames, metadata-only or camera-only apparent change

requirements.title: Character-specific performance
requirements.positive_acceptance: Two distinct character profiles produce intentional distinct performance
requirements.required_negative_control: Same profile trace, wrong owner, lag overrides constraint

requirements.title: Explicit smooth expression route
requirements.positive_acceptance: Directed actual intermediate expression cels or valid morph
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing middle cel, wrong order, wrong view, endpoint-only proof

requirements.title: Real visemes
requirements.positive_acceptance: Measured phones to contextual visemes and final audio placement
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing phone/closure, wrong audio digest, coarse substituted mouth

requirements.title: Facial composition legality
requirements.positive_acceptance: Compatible facial state tuples with masks and underpaint
requirements.required_negative_control: Double mouth, wrong emotion context, escaped pupil

requirements.title: Directed gaze and attention
requirements.positive_acceptance: Gaze, framing, readable attention and intended crop
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong gaze, head cropped, camera hides failed action

requirements.title: E01 coordinated performance acceptance
requirements.positive_acceptance: E01 source-derived coordinated acting checks and actual review
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing one owner action or wrong photo/hold timing

requirements.title: Pre-art closure and exact handoff
requirements.positive_acceptance: Complete sealed art demand with source lineage and approval gate
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing state tuple, stale hash, absent audit, fake measured geometry

requirements.title: Intake and registration
requirements.positive_acceptance: Native source intake, measured registration, rest recomposition
requirements.required_negative_control: Mirror, mismatched part, shifted crop, missing underpaint

requirements.title: Full moving-state closure
requirements.positive_acceptance: Every required frame evaluated for actual art feasibility
requirements.required_negative_control: Middle-frame failure, missing view, unintended upscale

requirements.title: Identity/view family and occlusion
requirements.positive_acceptance: Canonical view transitions and actual depth/occlusion
requirements.required_negative_control: Foreign identity, mirror, wrong paint order, missing view

requirements.title: Actual manual repair loop and producer routing
requirements.positive_acceptance: Real repair feedback routing and selective invalidation
requirements.required_negative_control: Stale candidate, wrong repair owner, unrelated master invalidated

requirements.title: Real image acceptance vs structural checks
requirements.positive_acceptance: Distinct engineering/real/human gates; approved exact film bytes
requirements.required_negative_control: Diagnostic or synthetic human approval rejected

requirements.title: World freeze/time remap
requirements.positive_acceptance: Exact source-world freeze, independently live host group
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong freeze frame, moving frozen prop, frozen host

requirements.title: Selective desaturation and transition
requirements.positive_acceptance: Selective grading and directed transition pixels
requirements.required_negative_control: Global grayscale, wrong mask, halo or wrong source

requirements.title: Perspective calibrated host/camera
requirements.positive_acceptance: Perspective calibrated Blender camera and actual rig projection
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong focal length, scale, float, gaze, flat substitute

requirements.title: Depth, matte and host/world compositing
requirements.positive_acceptance: Real RGBA/depth/matte and correct host occlusion/shadow
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong depth, stale pass, missing matte, host always in front

requirements.title: Camera orbit and 3D dolly
requirements.positive_acceptance: Real dolly/orbit with multi-depth projected anchors
requirements.required_negative_control: Flat zoom substitution, unapproved disocclusion

requirements.title: Model-driven decoder and truthful graphics
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual model-derived endpoint numbers and owner pixels
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong sign, denominator, stale model, wrong rendered value

requirements.title: Phone frustum and actual photography intent
requirements.positive_acceptance: Photo review geometry, correct lens and timing
requirements.required_negative_control: Report in photo, wrong orientation, early shutter

requirements.title: One timeline and real audio
requirements.positive_acceptance: Frame/sample exact audio, split continuation, mux checks
requirements.required_negative_control: Wrong take, duplicated cue, drift, lost frame

requirements.title: Efficient dependency-based production
requirements.positive_acceptance: Selective cache invalidation, deterministic resume and metrics
requirements.required_negative_control: Stale output reused or unrelated assets rebuilt

requirements.title: Full capability registry and action truth
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual generated action counts and complete capability matrix
requirements.required_negative_control: Missing row, unbound gate, stale blocker or false supported status

requirements.title: Evidence and mutation discipline
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual frozen test report and meaningful production mutation evidence
requirements.required_negative_control: Skipped test, fake verdict, evidence mismatch

requirements.title: Qualification order and stop conditions
requirements.positive_acceptance: Actual staged production gate chain and honest external-input status
requirements.required_negative_control: Unapproved output or unsupported route silently accepted

requirements.title: Consolidation
requirements.positive_acceptance: Safe ancestry reconciliation from newest tested head
requirements.required_negative_control: Lost source, stale evidence, private artifact publication or unauthorized merge
